# AIsa Developer Documentation

> One key and one MCP endpoint for LLMs and pay-per-call data APIs: web search and research, SEO, social, finance, crypto, prediction markets, and people/company data.

**Setting up AIsa as an agent?** Follow [the agent setup guide](https://aisa.one/llms.txt) first. It is the one place for how to connect, verify, use the MCP tools, approve spending, and handle errors. This file indexes the technical docs: load only the pages a task needs. Any docs page is available as Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL.

## Get started

- [Connect via MCP](https://aisa.one/docs/agent-quickstart): add `https://mcp.aisa.one/mcp`, sign in with OAuth, and verify with the free `account` operation.
- [Integrations](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/tutorials/use-aisa-in-claude): per-client setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Pi, Grok Build, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Muse, Grok Bot, Cue, and [your own agent](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/tutorials/use-aisa-in-your-custom-agents).
- [Use the CLI](https://aisa.one/docs/get-started/cli): for clients without MCP, plus the direct HTTP fallback.
- [Install the Agent Skill](https://aisa.one/docs/get-started/agent-skill): the official `aisa` skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents.
- [API Key & First Call](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/getting-started-with-aisa) and [OpenAI / Anthropic SDK](https://aisa.one/docs/get-started/sdk-compatibility): call AIsa over HTTP from your own code.
- [Machine Payments (MPP)](https://aisa.one/docs/integrations/machine-payments): pay for selected read-only data endpoints per request over HTTP 402 without an API key.

## Guides

- [How It Works](https://aisa.one/docs/how-it-works): authentication, endpoints, and billing in one request path.
- [Authentication](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/authentication): OAuth for MCP, Bearer API keys, storage, and rotation.
- [Billing & Credits](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/pricing): prepaid balance, per-call billing, cost quotes, maximum price, and spending limits.
- [Security & Privacy](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/security): key handling, data, write actions, and payments.
- [Model Catalog](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/models) and [Chinese Models](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/chinese-llms): model IDs, endpoints, and the live `/v1/models` list.
- [Data APIs](https://aisa.one/docs/resources/data-apis): data providers by category: Search & Research, Finance & Crypto, Social & Media, SEO & Web Intel, Sales & Email, Travel & Other.
- [Agent Skills](https://aisa.one/docs/agent-skills): installable skill bundles by category, with a guide to choosing between them.
- Examples: [Research Agent](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/research-agent), [Market Intelligence Agent](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/market-intelligence-agent), [Sales Research Agent](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/sales-research-agent), [Social Intelligence Agent](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/social-intelligence-agent), [Autonomous API Purchasing](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/autonomous-api-purchasing).

## Reference

- [API Reference](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference): every endpoint with its billing rules, grouped by category; [Credits Balance](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/credits-balance) checks the account.
- [Errors](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/errors) and [Rate Limits](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/rate-limits): error formats, retry guidance, and limit headers.
- Common entry points: [Chat Completions](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/chat/post_chat-completions), [Perplexity Sonar](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/perplexity/post_perplexity-sonar), [Scholar Search](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/scholar/post_scholar-search-scholar), [Financial Prices](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/financial/get_prices), [Twitter User Info](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/twitter/get_twitter-user-info), [Polymarket Events](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/prediction-market/get_polymarket-events), [SimilarWeb Similar Sites](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/similarweb/get_similarweb-website-similar-sites).
- [Agent Discovery](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/agent-discovery): A2A [Agent Card](https://aisa.one/.well-known/agent-card.json), OpenAPI, and MCP entry points.
- [FAQ](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/faq) and [Changelog](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/changelog).

## Optional

- [Complete OpenAPI JSON](https://aisa.one/openapi.json) and [YAML](https://aisa.one/openapi.yaml): the full interface contract, including method, parameters and declared pricing. Use for code generation.
- [MPP payment discovery](https://api.aisa.one/openapi.json): endpoints that accept machine payments, with their offers.
- [Full documentation bundle](https://aisa.one/docs/llms-full.txt): only for broad ingestion.
